title: Attention and Effort
coreMove: notice when a judgment requires scarce attention before you trust the first fluent answer
sourcePressure: shows that deliberate thought depends on limited attention and effort that can be stretched, spent, or overloaded
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: calling attention a moral virtue instead of a limited cognitive budget

starting in a lecture hall or generic seminar

smart people are immune if they know the term
